title: Trying to paint kingfisher blue
storyboard: Film: overhead watercolour of a kingfisher, timelapse, plus palette close-up mixing blues; 2 takes
caption:
Every paint set loses to this bird.

Kingfisher orange comes from pigment, but the blue comes from nanostructures inside the feather barbs that scatter blue light, which is why paint can only approximate it.

Source: Stavenga et al. 2011, Journal of Experimental Biology.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
